request.query: University enrolment and arrival steps (Tampere University)

sources.title: opiskelijanopas.tuni.fi
highlights: All students need to register as an attending (present) or non-attending (absent) student each academic year
For all new students in the degree programmes in English the registration takes place online
If you do not register at all by the given deadline, you lose your right to study
You need to be registered as present in order to participate in education, take exams and complete studies

sources.title: opiskelijanopas.tuni.fi
highlights: Therefore, once you have been granted a Finnish personal identity code, you should present the document along with your passport/identity card at the Student Affairs Office
